install_instrumentation_patches: install AST patchers to instrument Gemma transformer modules with activation callbacks
create_callback_for_activations: create a callback function that receives layer index, site, and JAX array values during forward pass
build_vars_from_callback: build model variables dictionary from a callback to invoke it at every layer and instrumentation site

review_site_enum: review the Site enum that defines instrumentation points within a Gemma forward pass
